quests.title: Let the Bloomflower Trials Begin!

dialogue.t: {NICKNAME} and Paimon! We meet at last.
Welcome to the Bloomflower Trials! I heard from our chief that you're here to sign up for the competition?
Yeah! But we were wondering, what exactly are the Bloomflower Trials about?
Ah, I'll give you a quick rundown.
First of all, the Bloomflower Trials are divided into "Offensive Battles" and "Defensive Battles."
Defensive battles are simple, just stop your opponents from attacking the tribe. Playing offense is trickier. Assuming your tribe's lost its defense, they have to sound a horn and counterattack.
To spice things up, we've added special ritual items into the mix. Attackers can charge them up to destroy the defenders' special barriers.
And even if this is a competition, we don't want to see uncalled-for violence or conflicts. Anything broken should be fixed, and if you see monsters, please clear them out.
Whoa... Paimon's head is spinning. {NICKNAME}, did you catch all that?

dialogue.sit: Um... Definitely one of the quick rundowns of all time.

dialogue.t: Don't sweat it! If you've got questions, come find me. The competition isn't that complicated, I'm sure you'll get the hang of it in no time if you participate.

quests.description: The Pyro Archon, Mavuika, has agreed to hold the Bloomflower Trials, and the competition venue is ready. All that’s left is to sign up for it…
